title: Jazzy Spanish English Muffins Fideua
description: A spicy and springy Spanish dish featuring English muffins, this recipe is a unique twist on traditional fideua, energizing and full of flavor. It is made with a bain-marie and is dash-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Toast the English muffins and cut them into small pieces.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the garlic and smoked paprika to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the red pepper flakes and salt to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and shredded cheese.
Add the toasted English muffin pieces to the bowl and stir to combine.
Pour the egg mixture into a baking dish and place the skillet on top.
Place the baking dish in a larger dish and add hot water to come halfway up the side.
Bake for 25 minutes or until the eggs are set.
